description: Pick pipelines, see where their time goes by step category, which steps fail (try category other), then open one run as a timeline.

panels.description: Task time of the pipelines in the range (approval waits excluded). Click a pipeline name to filter the whole dashboard on it.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOPipelineStepsTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and RecordType eq 'Task' and StepName ne 'ManualValidation' and StartedAt ge ${__from:date:iso} and StartedAt lt ${__to:date:iso})/groupby((Pipeline),aggregate(DurationSeconds with sum as Total,BuildId with countdistinct as Runs))

ADOTelemetry.ADOPipelineStepsTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and RecordType eq 'Task' and Result eq 'failed' and StartedAt ge ${__from:date:iso} and StartedAt lt ${__to:date:iso})/groupby((Pipeline),aggregate(RecordId with countdistinct as Failed))

panels.title: Pipelines by agent time (click a pipeline to filter)

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOPipelineStepsTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Pipeline:singlequote}) or Pipeline in (${Pipeline:singlequote})) and RecordType eq 'Task' and StepName ne 'ManualValidation' and StartedAt ge ${__from:date:iso} and StartedAt lt ${__to:date:iso})/groupby((Pipeline,Category),aggregate(DurationSeconds with sum as Sec))

panels.title: Where the time goes, per pipeline (share of task time by category)

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOPipelineStepsTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Pipeline:singlequote}) or Pipeline in (${Pipeline:singlequote})) and RecordType eq 'Task' and StepName ne 'ManualValidation' and StartedAt ge ${__from:date:iso} and StartedAt lt ${__to:date:iso})/groupby((StepName,Category),aggregate(DurationSeconds with sum as Total,RecordId with countdistinct as Calls))&$top=500

ADOTelemetry.ADOPipelineStepsTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Pipeline:singlequote}) or Pipeline in (${Pipeline:singlequote})) and RecordType eq 'Task' and Result eq 'failed' and StartedAt ge ${__from:date:iso} and StartedAt lt ${__to:date:iso})/groupby((StepName),aggregate(RecordId with countdistinct as Failed))&$top=500

panels.description: Steps that ended failed, with the error code and the first error line (scrubbed of paths, accounts, hosts, addresses and secrets). Error columns stay empty for runs collected before the collector change.

targets.oDataQueryString: ADOTelemetry.ADOPipelineSpansTyped?$apply=filter(('__all' in (${Organization:singlequote}) or Organization in (${Organization:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Project:singlequote}) or Project in (${Project:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Pipeline:singlequote}) or Pipeline in (${Pipeline:singlequote})) and ('__all' in (${Category:singlequote}) or Category in (${Category:singlequote})) and Kind eq 'Task' and Result eq 'failed' and startTime ge ${__from} and startTime lt ${__to})/groupby((Category,Pipeline,operationName,ErrorCode,ErrorMessage),aggregate(spanID with countdistinct as Failures,BuildId with max as LastBuild,duration with sum as Ms))&$top=500
